metadata.description: Rod Begbie's mods for Claude Code

plugins.name: context-bar
plugins.description: Draws the context window as a stacked bar above the prompt, toggled with /context-bar

plugins.name: pro-limits
plugins.description: Gauges for the 5-hour and weekly Claude usage limits above the prompt, toggled with /pro-limits

plugins.name: sportsball
plugins.description: Follow teams and see their live game scores above the prompt, with /follow-team, /unfollow-team, /following and /sportsball
